label: fly-ky7.11 amplitude control, first measurement on HEAD
question: Is the pilot's arm ordering an artefact of the real connectome delivering more signal to the readout, rather than computing better?
method: run_pilot --seeds 1 --steps 600 --eval-episodes 20 --coupling gather --minibatch 8, both variants. Calibration statistics are measured before training on 64 shared reference states, per arm, and now recorded in provenance.

amendment_A4.note: produced by the per-arm branching calibration that 7dd3bd6 removed as a confound

verdict: The amplitude ordering survives but the confound does not. Median readout s.d. is 0.5468 / 0.5380 / 0.5318 for real / shuffled / random, a spread of 2.8%. A4 recorded a factor of fourteen; the restored-window diagnosis predicted eleven percent. Measured through the real pipeline it is under three.
reasoning: The ordering real > shuffled > random is intact, so it is not noise in direction. Its magnitude is what has collapsed, from 1336 percent at A4 to 2.8 percent here.

Standardisation was real, not a no-op over a dead readout: dead units are 1, 1 and 0 of 44. That is precisely the distinction the calibration record was added to make, and it could not be checked before, because the statistics were computed and discarded.
Zero truncated episodes in all six arm-runs, so every score is a genuine terminal result.
caveats: One seed, 600 training steps against a registered budget of 500,000. The scores carry no information: raw is -1.0 on every arm, standardised is -1.0 / -0.9 / -0.9, which is one win in twenty on two arms and is noise. Only the calibration figures are informative here, and they are measured before training.

Measured at the production drive of 20.0, which drive_at_window_v783 shows puts the random arm in a runaway regime (active fraction 0.60 against a 0.25 ceiling) while the other two are not. The amplitude comparison inherits that.
Minibatch 8 rather than the registered 32, and gather rather than the default sparse. Both are recorded in config.
consequence: fly-ky7.11 can be answered, and at this point the answer is that the amplitude confound is small. What blocks the comparison is no longer the confound but the floor: at this budget every arm loses every game, so the evaluation has no discriminating power at all.
